No masterclass

The jump is too big

Someone who enjoys an episode of North Star Conversations goes from free content straight to an application. Most people aren’t ready for that leap, so they stay listeners.

Book not working as a funnel

Readers don’t become applicants

North Star Thinking builds trust, but nothing after the purchase moves a reader towards a conversation with you. The relationship stops at the last page.

No ads

Demand rises and falls with your output

7,760 posts is a lot of showing up. Every lead still depends on the next post or episode, and there’s no way to turn spend into qualified applications.

Anyone not ready to apply today leaves with nothing to say yes to, and you can’t tell who in your audience is ready.

My recommendation

A free North Star masterclass between your content and your qualify page

You already have a low-ticket product in your book. A free class gives the audience a reason to step forward, sells the book bundle on the thank-you page, and shows you who is serious enough to apply.

Fixes the missing bridge

A free 60-minute class is an easy yes for a listener or follower, and every sign-up is an email you own.

The 95%*

Not ready for coaching yet

They watch the free class, buy the North Star Thinking bundle, and join your newsletter. You get paid to start the relationship and stay in touch until they are ready.

The qualified 5%

Ready to step up from operator to owner

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before your calendar, and the pre-call emails warm them up for 1:1 or the Evolve Mastermind.

Sound familiar?

You built the business. Now it runs you.

  • You’re the operator, the salesperson and the fixer, and growth stalls every time you step back.
  • Your week is full of urgent tasks and the important ones keep moving to next week.
  • You know where you want to be in three years, but not what to do on Monday to get there.
  • You’ve worked hard on the business for years and want it to start working for you.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why working harder stops working

The point where more effort stops growing the business, and how to tell if you’ve reached it.

How to find your North Star

Set one clear direction for the business so every decision gets easier, including what to say no to.

Which hats to hand over first

A simple way to decide what only you should do, and what the business needs someone else to own.

How to build a week that doesn’t need you in every meeting

Time, energy and focus: the performance habits that protect the work only you can do.

What your next 90 days look like as the owner

Turn the plan into a short list of moves you can start this week.

Script 1 · “The operator trap”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If your business stops growing every time you take a week off, this is for you.”

Body

“Most entrepreneurs don’t have a growth problem. They have an operator problem. You’re doing every job, so the business can only grow as far as your hours stretch. The fix isn’t working harder. It’s changing which work is yours.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how in a free 60-minute masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, studio setup like your profile photo.

Script 2 · “The North Star”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do so many busy business owners feel like they’re standing still?”

Body

“Because without one clear direction, every opportunity looks urgent. Your North Star is the one thing that makes every other decision easier, including what to say no to. I wrote a book on it, and now I’m teaching the core of it live.”

CTA

“The North Star Masterclass. Free, 60 minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to North Star Thinking on the desk.

Script 3 · “Three hats”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here are the first three hats every founder should take off.”

Body

“You don’t hand over the business all at once. You start with the jobs that drain you most and need you least. Get those right and you win back the time to lead.”
